section: Iterate - feature: Reminders in the Inbox
title: Reminders and expired parks live in the Inbox; the sidebar count is the alert
context: Reminders need an alert surface. The operator chose the Inbox (no banner, bell or page); W1 gave the server bridge, W2 the Triage-look Inbox.
decision: Reminder and parked-triage rows join the project groups; one shared 120 s due query feeds page and sidebar count; Done/Snooze call the W1 routes; Start task pre-fills the New Task dialog; any unreadable answer is a banner, never 'nothing due'.
consequences: FR-01.76 minted. Reminder inputs live in components/reminders (outside the Inbox no-write fence, pinned by a test). Unreadable projects add 0 to the badge; the Inbox page shows the red banner.
rationale: Smallest option that meets the operator decision: presentation over existing routes, no new storage, stored command stays inert text, hostile text only as React text nodes.
rejected: Separate Reminders page or sidebar entry; header banner or bell; badge marker for unreadable projects (left for the operator to decide).
